rule.first_boundary: At 00:01 UTC, move from cash to the first target and charge its full L1 turnover.
rule.intermediate_boundaries: At each shared exit/entry boundary, mark the expiring positions at the verified common boundary prices and rebalance directly from those pretrade signed weights to the new target using net symbol-level changes; do not fabricate a separate flat exit and re-entry.
rule.last_boundary: After the final holding interval exits at 23:51 UTC, move the complete portfolio to cash and charge full liquidation turnover.
rule.turnover: Sum absolute signed-weight changes from marked pretrade weights to the new target across the union of symbols, including entry from and final marked exit to zero. A target-to-target calculation that ignores price drift is only a diagnostic lower bound.
rule.position_overlap: There is exactly one target portfolio on each half-open holding interval; old and new targets do not overlap in time even though the boundary rebalance is netted.
rule.cost_application: Apply the fixed base and stress all-in rates once to realized L1 turnover. Never charge a synthetic exit plus entry when a direct net rebalance is possible.

supersedes: wording in amendment 002 that could be read as forcing the portfolio flat before every new target
any implementation that charges two units of turnover at every ten-minute boundary regardless of unchanged holdings
unchanged: base 5 bp and stress 10 bp per unit of realized turnover
no return acquisition or live trading is authorized
